observations.behavior: Adds None to ConfigError.attr and its callers; the attr field is now optional and set to None for repeated keys or when no specific path is available.
observations.code_quote: super().__init__(first.detail if first.attr is None else f"{first.attr}: {first.detail}")
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the validation error to carry no specific field path while still preserving the error message, supporting cases where the backend cannot identify a precise nested field. This could help PostHog support repeated or ambiguous request keys without losing the error context.
